subject: general
question: As per February 2023 data, how many sports infrastructure projects have been approved under the Khelo India programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**323**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As of February 2023, a total of **323 sports infrastructure projects** have been approved under the Khelo India programme.
 
• The Khelo India programme is a flagship initiative launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to promote grassroots sports and develop infrastructure across India.
 
• These projects include the establishment of state-of-the-art facilities such as sports academies, training centers, and stadiums to nurture talent and improve access.
 
• The programme focuses on building a robust sports ecosystem, including talent identification and nurturing, sports education, and broadening community participation.
 
• Khelo India aims to engage youth in sports activities and provide them with an opportunity to excel at national and international levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Khelo India Programme:**

 
 
• Launched in 2018, the programme aims to revive India's sports culture at the grassroots level.
 
• It focuses on promoting "sports for all" and "sports for excellence."
 
• Under the initiative, athletes are provided scholarships and training facilities.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• State governments and sports authorities collaborate to develop infrastructure in rural and urban areas.
 
• Projects include stadium construction, synthetic tracks, swimming pools, and multi-purpose halls.
 
 
 
• **Talent Identification:**
 
 
• The programme identifies young talent through competitions like Khelo India Youth Games.
 
• Selected athletes are trained at specialized academies with advanced coaching facilities.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India:**
 
 
• India has seen increased participation in sports, especially among youth, due to the programme.
 
• The initiative is contributing to India's improved performance at international events.
